title: CmdPal: Port UI tests to UITestAutomation.Next (winappcli)

review.body_prefix:
Reviewed the new settings-search session relationship and the shared process/window targeting implementation. `CommandPaletteSession` is constructed with `Session.FromProcess`, so its `-a PID` searches include the same-process Command Palette Settings window; it is not a palette-window-only session. `SettingsSession` separately pins that Settings HWND for foreground checks. The reported reliable wrong-window failure is therefore not established by these call sites.

No required correction is requested for this examined scope. The existing title predicate deliberately uses a case-insensitive substring and the added shared-framework tests describe that behavior; changing it to exact equality solely to match a comment would alter the contract.

This assessment does not claim that the full new UI suite or the author's four-VM matrix was independently executed on the current revision. Packaged activation, signing, SamplePagesExtension deployment and full interactive workflows still require their intended UI-test environment; this is not unconditional approval of those unexecuted paths.
